versions.changelog:
- Initial release of work-productivity-nano-pdf-workflow-helper.
- Provides workflow and artifact support for Nano Pdf-style productivity tasks.
- Focuses on helping users fix bugs, improve reliability, harden setups, and create adjacent skills related to PDF/nano workflows.
- Includes a validated demand framework with clear triggers, task steps, and validation criteria.
- Outputs are designed to be immediately actionable and locally executable.
